question: Should OpenClaw accept this RFC's plugin-owned external verification boundary: one command-template `externalResolution` plus an ownership-checked `plugin.approval.resolveVerified` resolver using approval-specific authority?
rationale: The proposal defines future plugin API and approval authorization semantics, which automation cannot approve without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Continue Draft Review
options.body: Keep the RFC open while maintainers review the resolver boundary and wait for the promised AgentKit/OpenClaw proof.

options.title: Narrow The Boundary
options.body: Ask the author to reduce or split resolver authority, allow-always persistence, or presentation scope before acceptance.

options.title: Reject The Direction
options.body: Close the RFC direction if maintainers do not want external plugins to submit proof-backed approval resolutions through core.

recommendation.title: Continue Draft Review
recommendation.body: Keep the RFC open while maintainers review the resolver boundary and wait for the promised AgentKit/OpenClaw proof.

likelyOwner.reason: kevinslin is the visible reviewer for this RFC and authored the current RFC lifecycle guidance that gates draft acceptance.
